description: File-size classification rules. `npm run sizes:inventory` classifies every tracked file against the first matching rule and writes file-sizes.json. `npm run sizes:ratchet` fails the build when a file reaches `danger` without being grandfathered in size-ratchet.json, or when a grandfathered file grows. Thresholds are decomposition prompts, not hard architectural limits: `warn` means 'look for a seam', `danger` means 'split it before adding more'.

rules.title: Markdown documentation
rules.guidance: Split by audience or topic. A doc past 600 lines is usually two documents, or a live/planned pair that has drifted back together.

rules.title: Test and conformance source
rules.guidance: Table-driven cases and shared fixtures usually shrink these fast. Split by the behaviour under test, not by arbitrary line count.

rules.title: TypeScript source
rules.guidance: Extract cohesive state machines, framing/parsing helpers, or a barrel's re-exported members into their own modules.

rules.title: Build, tooling, and worklet scripts
rules.guidance: Move reusable steps into scripts/ modules and keep the entry point an orchestrator.

rules.title: JavaScript source
rules.guidance: Same decomposition guidance as TypeScript source.

rules.title: Native and Python source
rules.guidance: Bridges tend to accrete unrelated capabilities; split per capability or per platform API surface.
